headline: Ferry sold out. The car can still arrive one day late if the next sailing is booked today.

facts.text: The overnight vehicle crossing on 23 Oct 22:00 is sold out.
The earlier booking attempt timed out. No reservation exists.
The 24 Oct 12:00 sailing has a vehicle slot quoted, not booked.
The driver can take the later sailing if the overnight stop and return travel are arranged.
The dealer wants to approve any later delivery date before it is promised.

proposals.title: Book the 24 Oct 12:00 sailing and one hotel night near the terminal
proposals.rationale: It is the first sailing with a vehicle slot. The driver agreed if the overnight stop is arranged. Delivery moves one day, so the dealer must agree first.

changes.label: Hotel
changes.after: 1 night, 23 Oct, near West Baltic terminal

draftMessage.body: The overnight ferry for CD-420299 is sold out. The next sailing with space arrives one day later, so delivery would be 28 Oct 13:00–15:00. Can you confirm this works for the receiving contact?

proposals.whatHappensNext: On approval the agent sends the dealer this message. When the dealer agrees, it books the sailing and hotel and tells the driver. If the dealer says no, it comes back to you.
proposals.whatHappensAfter: The message to the dealer is on its way. The agent waits for their answer, then books the sailing and hotel and tells the driver. If the dealer says no, the case comes back to you.

steps.summary: The 07:10 booking attempt has no reference at the ferry line. Nothing was booked or charged.
23 Oct 22:00 sold out. 24 Oct 12:00 has a vehicle slot (quote, not booked). 24 Oct 22:00 has space but arrives too late for the driver's next job.
The driver already wrote at 08:05 that the later sailing works if the overnight stop and return travel are arranged. The dealer wants to approve any later date first.
3 hotels within 10 minutes of the terminal, from € 89.

steps.text: Booking costs money and moves the delivery a day, and the dealer said they must approve a later date first. This needs a person.

steps.summary: Waiting for a yes on the rebooking and the message to the dealer.

timeline.text: I have the gig for CD-420299, but I do not have a ferry reference. Is the overnight vehicle crossing booked?
The overnight sailing returned sold out. The later sailing has a quote only. Check driver rest and customer promise before purchase.
Please keep us informed. We need to approve a later delivery date before it is promised to the receiving contact.
